name: AudioMuse-AI Instant Mix
author: AudioMuse
description: Replaces the Instant Mix button with AudioMuse-AI recommendations for similar tracks

apiUrl.title: AudioMuse-AI API URL
apiUrl.description: Base URL for the AudioMuse-AI server (e.g., http://192.168.3.203:8000).

apiToken.title: API Token
apiToken.description: Optional Bearer token for AudioMuse-AI API authentication. Leave blank if not required.

server.title: Server Name
server.description: Server name as configured in AudioMuse-AI multi-server setup (e.g. 'Navidrome'). Leave blank if multi-server is not used; the parameter will not be sent.

artistSimilarCount.title: Number of Similar Artists
artistSimilarCount.description: Maximum number of similar artists to request from AudioMuse-AI. Default: 10

instantMixSource.title: Instant Mix Functionality
instantMixSource.description: Which AudioMuse-AI similarity engine powers Instant Mix. 'Lyrics by Song' needs the SemGrove index and 'Hyperbolic Similarity' needs the hyperbolic projection built in AudioMuse-AI. Default: Similar Song.

eliminateDuplicates.title: Eliminate Duplicates
eliminateDuplicates.description: Remove duplicate tracks from results. Default: true

radiusSimilarity.title: Use Radius Similarity
radiusSimilarity.description: Use radius-based similarity algorithm. Default: true

excludeArtists.title: Exclude artists
excludeArtists.description: List of artists to exclude from responses. One artist per-line.

excludeAlbums.title: Exclude albums
excludeAlbums.description: List of albums to exclude from responses. Each line should be an album name, or AlbumArtist//Album

genreGroups.title: Genre groups
genreGroups.description: Each line should be a comma separated list of genres defining a single group. One group per-line.

excludeSeedArtist.title: Exclude seed artist
excludeSeedArtist.description: For most mixes AudioMuse returns tracks of same artist, should these be excluded?

oneOf.title: Exclude all occurances (if only a few tracks requested)

minDuration.title: Minimum duration
minDuration.description: Minimum duration of similar tracks. Default: 0

maxDuration.title: Maximum duration
maxDuration.description: Maximum duration of similar tracks. Default: 0 (no maximum)

filterXmas.title: Only allow 'Christmas' genre in December
filterXmas.description: Don't use tracks with 'Christmas' genre unless its December. Default: true

shuffle.title: Shuffle response
shuffle.description: Shuffle list before returning. Default: true

remove.title: Randomly remove tracks
remove.description: Randomly remove some tracks so that same tracks are not always returned. Default: true

config.reason: To read plugin configuration in Navidrome UI

http.reason: To call AudioMuse-AI API for similar tracks

matcher.reason: Resolve seed track ID to library track
